svg.text: HaqDesk AI – Unified Inbox & Customer Support Use Case Diagram
Standard UML 2.5 Use Case Specification · Human-in-the-Loop AI & Omnichannel Workspace
System Boundary: HaqDesk AI – Unified Customer Support

g.text: 1. Inbound Channel Message: External Customer messages (Messenger, IG, WhatsApp, Email) are delivered via generic Communication Platform.
2. AI Grounded Drafting: System analyzes message sentiment, retrieves tenant-scoped knowledge, and generates an AI draft reply.
3. Human Oversight (Default): Support Staff/Admin reviews the AI draft, with full power to Accept, Edit, or Reject the suggestion.
4. Controlled Outbound Delivery: Only human-approved or manually written responses are dispatched back through the original channel.
* Note: Business Admin can optionally configure Auto AI Mode to bypass manual review for instant automated replies.
UML 2.5 Notation: —— Association - - - > <<include>> / <<extend>> Dependency ———▷ Generalization ( ) Use Case
